findings.location:
...침상 매너(bedside manner)...

(section: "Not All Doctors Are Equal")
findings.source_quote: Most of us look for someone who exudes confidence and seems to know what they are doing.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate or provide a fully Korean equivalent for the parenthetical English term. For example: replace '침상 매너(bedside manner)' with '침상 매너(환자 응대 태도)' or simply '환자 응대 태도' while preserving the surrounding HTML tags and order.
findings.translation_quote: 의사를 만날 때 우리는 보통 그들의 ‘침상 매너(bedside manner)’를 보고 판단합니다.

findings.source_quote: The fact that your mother’s cousin took milkweed extract and felt much better from similar symptoms to yours is interesting.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the plant name into Korean or use a common Korean rendering without leaving the English in parentheses. For example: replace '밀크위드(milkweed)' with '밀크위드(송악/풀이름 - if appropriate common name known)' or '밀크위드(밀크위드 추출물)' depending on editorial convention. Preserve the surrounding HTML tags and order.
findings.translation_quote: 당신의 어머니 사촌이 밀크위드(milkweed) 추출물을 복용하고 당신과 비슷한 증상에서 훨씬 좋아졌다는 사실은 흥미롭습니다.
